title: Heaven Is a Place for Sociopaths

top_liked.author: @DogladywithaCat

top_liked.author: @TheRealLurtz
top_liked.text: My mom’s answer to that question of how she can be in heaven if I, as an atheist, won’t be there. Her response? God will make her forget about me.

top_liked.author: @SnakeWasRight
top_liked.text: They condemn any worldliness as hedonism, but they beg for the literal most extreme hedonism possible.  Eternal bliss without ceasing.
